notes.title: Patch 0.758 Quality of Life improvements and bug fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.758 introduces a highly requested quality-of-life feature: [b]Recipe Book[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]One of the most common complaints from players was the recipe limit—only being able to learn up to 3 recipes at once, and having to discard one when exceeding capacity. Losing a hard-earned recipe felt frustrating, and worse, relearning it cost extra money.[/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Recipe Book[/b] solves this frustration. When you learn a recipe for the first time, a Recipe Book of that recipe will be added to your inventory. You can use the Recipe Book to re-learn that recipe at any time, unlimited times. This makes recipes collectible and allows you to freely swap the dishes you can cook.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also added a setting to invert the Y-axis for players who prefer that control style.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other changes, bug fixes, and improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Minor Change:[/b] Removed the Wishlist button for Early Access.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where cooks or servers’ right hands could get stuck in a “carrying plate” position.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Guest orders are now cancelled if the player apologizes for not having the required ingredients.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed interaction tags that could remain on objects after Build Mode and couldn’t be cleared.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where players couldn’t scroll past the first 10 decorations in Orb Mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed display issues with existing advertisements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed incorrect contract price display for items.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Players can now cook any recipe at any time.[/p][list][*][p]Previously, you could only cook recipes that were on the menu. This was meant to preserve ingredients early on but became restrictive later.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead, you can cook any recipe you know, but cooking is now locked until [b]Day 3[/b], ensuring smooth early-game progression.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improvement (Settings):[/b][/p][list][*][p]Simplified Game Speed settings to [b]Slow, Normal, Fast[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified V-Sync settings to [b]30, 60, 120, 150 fps[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Invert Y-Axis Control[/b] option.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unintuitive texture quality settings and localization issues.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Customers will no longer be scheduled too late when there are too few of them, reducing unnecessary waiting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Added a tutorial page for [b]Advertisement[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.757 Performance Optimization and bug fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.757 is an important update for [b]Steam Deck players[/b], focusing on performance optimization in [i]Magic Inn[/i]. These improvements should effectively resolve:[/p][olist][*][p]Crashes when visiting the Central Market.[/p][/*][*][p]Crashes when visiting the Crop Market during busy times.[/p][/*][*][p]Crashes when too many customers appear at once.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Tests show:[/p][list][*][p]~15% reduction in CPU and GPU usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Nearly 40% reduction in memory usage when many characters are present in the scene.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additional Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where characters didn’t sit properly on chairs and appeared to float near tables if the player entered Build Mode before opening the inn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an exploit in Build Mode where furniture could be infinitely duplicated by spawning it for placement and then pressing [i]Collect[/i] to cancel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the starting camera angle when entering a new scene, such as the market or the inn.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Improvement:[/b] When switching to Orb Mode, the camera now cuts cleanly instead of using a slow transition that could feel dizzying.[/p][/*][/list][p]A huge thank-you to all the players who reported these bugs and for your patience with our buggy little game—I truly appreciate it![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.756: Major Staff AI Fixes and Applying for a loan
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Sorry it took a few days to prepare [b]Patch 0.756[/b]. This update includes major fixes for staff AI and introduces a new feature that lets you apply for a loan from the Central Market at any time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Staff AI Fixes[/b]
Previously, chefs often prepared customer orders in the wrong priority, which could prevent you from serving customers and risk losing regulars. They would even waste time making orders that had already been cancelled when customers left, and in some cases a bug caused chefs to remake duplicate orders.[/p][p]With this patch, chefs will now:[/p][list][*][p]Prioritize orders based on customer patience.[/p][/*][*][p]Avoid preparing cancelled orders.[/p][/*][*][p]No longer create duplicate orders.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your chefs should now behave more predictably and work efficiently to serve every customer.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Server and Plate Fix[/b]
Previously, if your server picked up a plate while you were using magic to fly it, a race condition could occur—causing the server to carry “air” instead of the plate. This “air” would then occupy space on the table, causing the server to get stuck and making it impossible to serve that customer.[/p][p]With this patch, the game now handles both scenarios correctly—whether you fly the plate first or the server picks it up first. Servers should no longer get stuck.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Feature[/b]
You can now apply for a loan at the Loan Stall in the Central Market at any time. For players struggling with money, this should be a helpful option once you’ve unlocked access to the Central Market.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Fixes and Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Interacting with the advertisement in the phone booth and clicking multiple times before the UI transition is complete no longer freezes the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Events are now scheduled even if treated as expired. This fixes issues—especially for players transferring demo save files—where important events expired and blocked story progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] A cutting board placed on top of a counter should prevent other items from being placed on that counter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Cooks searching for a counter will now look for the closest empty one available.[/p][/*][/list][p]I apologize for these issues and truly appreciate all of your support! Next, I’ll be focusing on the major performance issues on Steam Deck that are causing crashes in the later stages of the game.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.755 Conversation Card Game Improvement + Controller Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Patch 0.755 focuses on improving the [b]conversation card game[/b], especially the Negotiation game.[/p][p]I know I previously mentioned working on staff AI, but we’ve received a lot of feedback from players that the Negotiation card game felt unfairly difficult, and that the emotion system didn’t seem to matter. Because of this, I’ve shifted priorities to address these issues first.[/p][p]This patch also includes two [b]critical bug fixes[/b] for controller users, as well as adjustments to decoration attributes and prices. Now, higher-attribute items will demand higher prices, and more difficult-to-craft items will reward greater attributes—making it feel more balanced.[/p][p][b]Details of this patch:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Gameplay:[/b] Adjusted the difficulty of the Negotiation Card Game:[/p][list][*][p]Give an extra Negotiate card to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the confidence required to play the Negotiate card.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the discount amount rival characters can impose.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay:[/b] Reworked how emotions affect the conversation card game. Emotions now have a more meaningful impact, especially in [i]Attraction [/i]topic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay:[/b] Improved the mechanics of the [i]Convince[/i] card. Its effects can now stack, and it will only be consumed when its effects are applied.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Critical Fix:[/b] When selecting a destination to travel to, choosing “No” no longer causes the menu to freeze and force the player to quit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Critical Fix:[/b] During the conversation card game, using the [i]Silence[/i] card and quickly pressing the select button no longer causes a crash that locked player movement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a configuration issue with the walls of the main market shop that caused icons to be hidden.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] In Laurel’s Inn, the player’s bedroom window no longer allows visibility into a guest bedroom.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balance:[/b] Adjusted decoration attributes and prices across all items.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.754 More Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve been traveling the past few days and wasn’t able to work on the game, but now I’m back and will be pushing more patches in the near future.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.754 is primarily a bug-fix update, aimed at making the game more stable and smooth:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where, for unknown reasons, guests staying in the inn did not have matching records, causing a game-breaking bug with an empty guest list and no new guests arriving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Wallpaper “Chocolate” tile was not accessible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where wallpaper changes sometimes wouldn’t save after placement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] During the [i]Build a Mortar[/i] task, players received a Magic Spirit item. This item is now marked as a quest item and cannot be sold; otherwise, players could get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where players could walk into market stalls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed the tutorials for [i]Contract[/i] and [i]Fire Travel[/i].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] At the start of Act 2, talking to Luka now correctly clears his notification.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed camera angles during group dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] After learning a new recipe, players can now use the controller to select a recipe to discard.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] The top part of the bar is now transparent when it obstructs the line of sight.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We truly appreciate all the support from the community! We’ll also begin brainstorming new content for Act 2 soon. If you’d like to participate, you’re more than welcome to join our Discord and chat with us directly![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.753 Can't use Recipe Fix
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Unfortunately, my last patch introduced a critical bug that prevented players from learning recipes.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.753 fixes this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m very sorry for the mistake, and I promise to do better next time by doing more testing, especially on new features before release.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry again for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.752 Bulk Purchase + Critical Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.752 introduces a new quality-of-life feature: [b]bulk purchasing[/b] in shops.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, in the shopping menu, each click on an item added only a single unit to the cart. This was tedious if a player wanted to buy larger quantities—like 20 of the same item. With bulk purchase, holding [b]Shift[/b] while clicking will now add [b]10 items[/b] at a time to the cart.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch also fixes two critical bugs:[/p][olist][*][p]When talking with a character, clicking too quickly could cause the conversation to get stuck and the game to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]When loading a game or starting a new day, the player could get locked in place and had to press extra buttons to regain control.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Finally, a few minor fixes were made for the Simplified Chinese language version:[/p][list][*][p][b]Minor Fix:[/b] Removed incorrect tooltip when opening the map that hinted players could click on it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Fix:[/b] Localized additional text into Simplified Chinese.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Fix:[/b] Fixed incorrect control icon display during tutorials in the Simplified Chinese version.[/p][/*][/list][p]More improvements and fixes are coming tomorrow![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.751 Fire Travel Quest Fix
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s patch (0.751) is a small bug-fix update, mainly focused on addressing the issue where players were unable to complete the Fire Travel quest.[/p][p][/p][p]If a player hired a special character too early, it could break story progression, preventing the abandoned inn from appearing on the map. In the last patch, I added a safeguard to stop this from happening. With this patch, the game will now also detect if your save file is already stuck and attempt to repair it automatically.[/p][p][/p][p]This patch also fixes a bug introduced in a recent update where, after upgrading the inn, the task display would error out and fail to show correctly.[/p][p][/p][p]I’ll continue working on reported issues—thank you all so much for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.75 Emergency Fix
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]In the last patch (0.749), I mistakenly carried over the demo’s progression locks into the Early Access version. This prevented many players from advancing the story.[/p][p][/p][p]I sincerely apologize for this mistake and for the frustration it has caused![/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.75 fixes this issue. When you load your save file, the game will automatically detect and remove the locks. Missing events will also be restored so you can continue the story.[/p][p][/p][p]From now on, the Early Access version will also accept save files from the demo. When loading them, the game will remove the demo locks and restore missing events, allowing you to continue seamlessly.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, the game now prevents players from hiring a certain special character too early, as doing so could also block story progression.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and understanding![/p]

notes.title: State Of The Game
notes.content:
[p][b][i]STATE OF THE GAME:[/i][/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/8827f10abee6bb1f1e1ec20ed4dd9a0207ab6f32.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi Magic Innkeepers![/p][p][/p][p]I am Arutha the Community Director for Magic Inn.  I have been working closely with the development team to provide you some updates on where the game is at, and where we plan on going.[/p][p][/p][p]So first off, thank you so much to everyone who has tried our game and provided helpful feedback! As you all know we launched with more bugs than expected, and the development team has been hard at working at squashing all of them!!! [/p][p][/p][p][b][i]1.0 What we have been doing since Early Access Release.[/i][/b][/p][p]
Our team has been doing what any good development team does after releasing....[b][i]LISTENING TO YOU![/i][/b]:)[/p][p]That's right we have working tirelessly to take your feedback, and use it to make the game [b]better.[/b][/p][olist][*][p]We have made major adjustments to the controls of the game both for PC and Steam Deck. [/p][/*][*][p]Squashing A LOT of critical and minor bugs that our awesome Early Access players have taken the time to bring to our attention! Thank you so much to every player who has given us this valuable feedback![/p][/*][*][p]We have majorly revamped the camera controls to make our game an even better experience for those who have motion sickness![/p][/*][*][p]Controller support in general has been greatly advanced. We now fully support controllers in both PC and Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]New decoration are IN!! Check out the plushy toy merchant in Act 2, you won't want to miss it![/p][/*][*][p]As mentioned before we have made control adjustments on Steam Deck but also additional changes to make Magic Inn [b][i]FULLY COMPATIBLE with Steam Deck[/i][/b].  We have some minor changes to make to get our fully coveted green check mark from Steam for it, but rest assured, we [b][i]will[/i][/b] get it!![/p][/*][*][p]We now have full Steam Cloud Saves enabled! Feel free to play on PC or Steam Deck and your saves will now by synced and usable from either device.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][b][i]2.0 Where is the game headed next!?? What is coming!?[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][olist][*][p]We will continue to monitor and fix bugs along the way, we take our duty seriously! Plus we have exterminators on speed dial.... [/p][/*][*][p]The game will have 3 Acts, and right now only 20% of Act 2 is currently present.  We intended to complete Act 2 by the end of 2025. This is a tentative estimate, as we must allow for...well anything to happen. But that is our current goal.[/p][/*][*][p]We will be planning on expanding our inventory of decorations as we go along building out Act 2 and Act 3, so expect many more of these to come![/p][/*][*][p]We will be constantly reviewing all three Acts for any necessary Quality of Life improvements we feel are necessary based on player feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Honestly to a large extent, what happens next is largely up to our players. We will be inviting player feedback on the future Acts and content of this game and taking it and making it a reality. So please feel free to help us decide what happens next! More on this will be coming out over the future weeks.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][b][u]Conclusion:[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Myself, Xiao, and Summer all wish to once again thank each and every person who has made Magic Inn their home, and even more gratitude to those who have taken the time to provide feedback! Anyone who wants to contribute with their feedback please reach out to us on the Magic Inn discord! [/p][p]Discord Link: [url="https://discord.gg/nSMMzB3WAf"]https://discord.gg/nSMMzB3WAf[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Arutha[/p][p]Community Director[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.749 Full Controller Support, Steam Deck Support and Steam Cloud
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]With Patch 0.749, [i]Magic Inn[/i] now has [b]full controller support[/b] and is fully playable on the Steam Deck! In addition, Steam Cloud saves are now supported![/p][p][b]Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players on Steam Deck may experience crashes when visiting the market at night. As a temporary workaround, please go to [b]Settings → Graphics[/b] and turn off [b]Fog[/b]. I’ll continue working on performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p]With the current Steam Cloud configuration, different Steam accounts on the same computer will share the same save files.[/p][/*][/list][p]This patch also includes two critical crash fixes—one during inn decoration and another when opening a chest with a controller.[/p][p]Next, I’ll focus on fixing more bugs, including staff AI issues, as well as adding quality-of-life features like manual saves and bulk purchases.[/p][p]In our Discord, players have also provided great feedback on some plot issues, which I’ll be improving soon. More updates are coming, and a huge thanks to our playtesters in Discord for helping us find and report these bugs![/p][p][b]Summary of this patch:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a crash when decorating the inn. If a player collected an item attached to another object first, the game would crash when attempting to collect the attached object.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed a crash when opening a chest using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where, after changing screen resolution, the cutting minigame could spawn UI elements in abnormal positions, preventing completion and causing the player to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Added the ability to use a controller to select different regions and destinations on the world map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Players can now use controllers to purchase hiring services.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controls Adjustment:[/b] Simplified entering Build Mode or Magic Mode—now accessible with a single key instead of a key combination.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simplified Controls:[/b] Removed assigning items to the item wheel. Items can now only be used directly from the inventory menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Fix:[/b] Balanced the cutting minigame difficulty on Steam Deck, which was previously harder than on PC due to resolution differences.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Added missing icons for certain conversation cards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Small Fix:[/b] The chest under the loan stall is no longer interactable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Small Fix:[/b] Changed the developer command key from [b]F12[/b] to [b]F8[/b] so it no longer conflicts with the screenshot key.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dialogue Fix:[/b] Corrected dialogue with the Caretaker that was mistakenly assigned to the wrong character.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Fix:[/b] Adjusted the location of control mappings in the staff management menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Cloud Support:[/b] Save files are now synced with Steam Cloud.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.748 Controller Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s update focuses mainly on fixes related to controller support. One major feature still missing for controllers is the ability to select a region (such as the Central Valley) during Fire Travel. This will take a bit more time to implement correctly.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, new bugs have been reported. I’ve read through all of them and am actively working on fixes. I know there are still quite a few unresolved issues, and I want to sincerely apologize and thank you for your patience.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, the [i]Magic Inn[/i] Demo has been updated with the latest improvements. However, if you previously played the demo and are now starting the Early Access version, you will unfortunately need to restart. The demo save file still has certain plot and upgrade locks in place. This will be addressed in a future update.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes in this patch:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Interaction Fix:[/b] Improved interaction when NPCs are seated—it’s now easier to talk to them from the right side of the table.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Interaction Fix:[/b] Adjusted the position of interaction hints for tables and the bartending stand.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Use the left and right triggers to switch tabs during character customization.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] You can now use the controller to use items in your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] You can now use the controller to click on the world map to enter the outer view.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Disabled all controller-triggered actions in the guest list, as these features are not yet ready.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] You can now use the controller to accept or reject a contract.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed an issue where, during card games with a controller, the game would sometimes incorrectly display topic cards, wasting the player’s turn.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.747 Critical Bug fix
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The previous patch (0.746) introduced a bug that prevented players from leaving the market or using Fire Travel.[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 0.747 fixes this issue.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the inconvenience![/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.746 Controls and Interactions Overhaul and Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]This patch introduces a major overhaul of the controls and interaction system. As many of you have experienced, interacting with objects in [i]Magic Inn[/i] could feel finicky, unstable, and unpleasant. This update aims to resolve those issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Combined with the previous patch’s camera improvements, the game should now feel smoother, more intuitive to control, and more reliable. It might not be perfect yet, and I will continue refining it. Please let me know if the controls still feel awkward—your feedback would be a tremendous help![/p][p][/p][p]Tomorrow, my focus will finally return to adding Steam Deck support, implementing Steam Cloud saves, and of course, addressing more reported bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Summary of Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Completely overhauled the interaction system to replace janky controls and unintuitive object interactions with a smoother, more responsive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Improvement:[/b] Players can now aim higher with the camera.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] For interactions that require holding a key, the game now displays a “hold” instruction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvement:[/b] Cleaning or crafting actions will now automatically stop once completed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Sleeping early no longer causes players to skip important end-of-day events and miss story progression tasks. These events will now be scheduled for the next day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Sprinting now begins when the Shift key is pressed, not when it is released.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Fixed the functionality of the [i]Convince[/i] card.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where the game would keep swapping control mappings between PC and controller.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.745 Emergency Bug Fix
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]I’ve just realized that my previous control fix accidentally broke Luka’s letter tutorial, which could block many players from progressing. I sincerely apologize for this mistake.[/p][p]This patch addresses the following issues:[/p][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Completing Luka’s letter task would prompt the player to press “Ctrl” to collect, but pressing it had no effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b] Occasionally, guests would arrive with an invalid emotion, which could cause the game to crash.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your understanding![/p]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.744 Bug Fixes and Plushies
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Today’s patch is focused mainly on bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]Aside from fixing issues, tomorrow I’ll begin optimizing player interactions with objects and improving controller support. Hopefully, by the end of this weekend, you’ll be able to enjoy a smooth experience on the Steam Deck![/p][p][/p][p][b]Camera Adjustment:[/b] In Build Mode, the camera will now automatically avoid obstacles such as walls and ceilings when placing decorations.[/p][p]
[b]Plushies:[/b] Added adorable plushies to the plushie stall in the market—be sure to check them out![/p][p]
[b]Improvement:[/b] The True North building in the Central Market has received a fresh coat of paint and polish.
[/p][p][b]Balance:[/b] Adjusted the room attributes for the Act 2 Inn.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when the newspaper displayed both a North Star award and an advertisement at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual glitch in Luka’s letter tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where loan interest was being deducted twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Players can no longer sell items when their gold is negative.[/p][/*][*][p]The Magic Stall in the market will no longer spawn, as it’s not ready yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed room prices stays 0 in the Act 2 Inn’s bedroom even after decoration.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where random chests could spawn in mid-air or on top of characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Pumpkin Lantern could not be picked up after placement.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Patch Version 0.743 Rainy Day Task Adjustment and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hi, everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Today I have to spend a lot of time fixing a single bug, so I couldn't get to the others as much. I'm aware of all of the issues, and I will hopefully make more progress fixing them tomorrow. Here is a summary of this patch:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Task Adjustment:[/b]
Many players reported that the [i]Rainy Day[/i] task could not be completed due to a lack of dirty tables. This task has now been adjusted to only appear on days when it can actually be completed.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tutorial Controller Mapping:[/b] Fixed an issue where, during the tutorial, controller users would sometimes see PC key prompts instead. notes.title: Release Delayed Again
notes.content:
Hi everyone,  🪄🪄

We’re sorry to announce that the release date for [i]Magic Inn[/i] will be delayed once again.

Since launching [i]Magic Inn: Prologue[/i] and our demo back in February, we've noticed that many players have struggled with aspects of the gameplay, and several bugs have significantly impacted the experience. It's become clear to us that the game needs more time and care to truly fulfill its potential.

Alongside developing exciting new features for Early Access, we've been addressing these issues. However, it causes delays in our planned schedule. This wasn't an easy decision, but we believe it’s necessary for the best possible experience.

Here’s what we’ve been focusing on:

[list]
[*] Enhanced Tutorial: We've completely redesigned the tutorial, incorporating clearer instructions, multi-step tasks, and smoother storytelling to provide seamless onboarding.

[*] Improved User Interface: We've simplified and standardized our UI menus, ensuring a consistent and user-friendly experience throughout the game.

[*] More Magic: We’re significantly expanding our spell collection—though we don’t want to spoil too much!

[*] Expanded Decorations: We've introduced many adorable new decorations, including fresh wallpaper and flooring options. Our build mode has also been enhanced to allow even greater customization flexibility.

[*] Bug Squashing: Naturally, we're tackling all known bugs and any new ones that arise.
[/list]
Our tentative release window is now set for [b]Q2 2025[/b]. However, we want to be fully confident in the game's quality before confirming a final date. We plan to update our demo once we've thoroughly playtested these changes and feel satisfied with the improvements.

Here is a teaser screenshot of our lighting improvements. Hope you all think it looks much better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/ca978916f9952cf47aebde7fe96f90bd707428a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/e3ba2f1c3acc6efc98d58a35ddd8999ff2484539.png[/img]

We truly appreciate your patience and continued support. 

With love 💖,

Magic Inn Dev Team

notes.title: Release Date is delayed
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 🌟

We’re sorry to announce that we’ve decided to postpone the release date of [i]Magic Inn[/i] to [b]April 2025[/b]. 

As this is our first game, we’ve been a bit too ambitious and lacked experience in setting realistic development goals. Even though we’ve been working tirelessly, we have to remind ourselves that we’re a small team of just four people, with only one programmer. 

[i]Magic Inn[/i] is like our baby. We’ve poured all our love and passion into raising it more than three years from nothing to where it is now. That’s why we don’t want to compromise at the finish line of this long marathon.

We need about three more months to complete one final feature and dedicate a significant amount of time to playtesting. While we can’t promise that every aspect of the gameplay will be perfect for everyone, we’re committed to ensuring a bug-free experience so your time with [i]Magic Inn[/i] is as enjoyable as possible.

Thank you so much for your patience, understanding, and continued support. 💗

With love, 
Magic Inn dev team 🪄🪄

notes.title: Demo Available (Story Mode)

Hello Wizards!

We are thrilled to announce that our [b]newest demo[/b] is now available for everyone to play!

If you've tried our previous demos, you're in for a surprise—this version is a game-changer! We've completed the story mode, putting you in the shoes of a novice innkeeper on a mission to transform a shabby inn into a cozy, magical hub of profit and enchantment.

For those who haven't experienced [i]Magic Inn[/i] yet, here's what sets us apart: our unique blend of a magical theme and a deep focus on building relationships with every guest you meet. notes.title: Conversation in Magic Inn: Words of Battle
notes.content:
Hello fellow wizards!

You might think innkeeping is easy, and that you can use your spells to breeze through all of the challenges. Unfortunately, not everything can be solved with a wave of your wand.

Today, I’m introducing you to a powerful weapon that can influence people’s minds. No, it’s not a spell. It’s the art of conversation.

[h1]Conversation[/h1]

Non-magic folks have mastered the art of conversation for centuries. It is a vital skill that can save you gold, gather information, recruit talent, build connections, and most importantly, persuade your rivals to make key decisions that can impact the world.

A conversation is only meaningful when it has a topic, as the topic defines a goal. By conversing on the same topic, you gain experience, and when you level up, you unlock skillful cards that allow you to outwit even the toughest opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/0d26768d573519bc5e3e6d569c5c893a573476a7.png[/img]

Let’s go over some of the most important topics you need to master, and the rewards you can earn from them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/403f5a773ecb10ed83b10f7fd3f3c0c617e40c82.png[/img]

[h2]Negotiation[/h2]

You will find yourself trading goods from time to time with local farmers or merchants. Farmers are fine. But merchants are the worst to deal with, as they trade for a living and excel at the art of negotiation. In Negotiation, you aim to secure a good discount rate, which applies whether you are buying or selling items. A higher discount rate means better prices, no matter which side of the trade you are on. Neglect this, and your purse will empty faster than you think.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/fe385261caabc16fe4546dbff07ace9405f4a1cd.png[/img]

[h2]Inquiry[/h2]

The practice of Inquiry is all about collecting useful intel on the people you deal with. Information such as their specialties and skills, favorite food and items, and who their friends are can inform you how to befriend them and how helpful they can be. Without this intel, you are flying blind. Nothing feels worse than giving a gift to someone who doesn’t even like it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/c7770077eb8cceb93def0936807d8def96e4c7ba.png[/img]

[h2]Employment[/h2]

To scale up your operations, you need to hire talent. Convincing local cooks to join you isn’t too difficult, but when your inn starts attracting royalty, you’ll need to employ the best chefs on the continent. The back-and-forth salary with top chefs will be, let’s say, an interesting conversation to be had.

[h2]Attraction[/h2]

To be a successful innkeeper, it is a given that you must be likable, or at least, pretend to be likable. Mastering the art of attraction gives you a powerful tool to quickly win people’s hearts. Moreover, you’ll have a much easier time developing romantic relationships. If that’s not motivation, I don’t know what is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/3d009643febe7a192cf65021bb3995813cd240d4.png[/img]

[h2]Battle[/h2]

Yes, a battle of words! Exciting, isn’t it? In many situations, you will have to engage in a debate battle with your opponent that you cannot afford to lose. When you get really good at it, you can participate in local tournaments where you will earn high honor for being the best debater in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/44374b4df3090186355098f730274142ee0f6ae4.png[/img]

[h1]Final Remarks[/h1]

If what you’ve read interests you, dive in to learn the mechanics of conversation, a turn-based card battle system, and master the topics to influence this magical world.

Wishlist and follow the game to be notified about more updates, demos, and the launch!

notes.title: Introducing Magic Inn
notes.content:
Greetings wizards!

We are thrilled to have you here and can't wait to share our creative vision with you.

In this devlog, we'll give you a bird's-eye view of Magic Inn: what it's all about and a hint of the story driving your journey.

[h1]What is Magic Inn[/h1]

Magic Inn places you in the role of a business owner in a Harry-Potter-inspired magic fantasy world.

[h2]Business Owner[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/4c2f16067789c1049cf5f61de3f529b15f928dd1.gif[/img]

Before anything else, your inn is your business. You'll manage many aspects of the inn, such as staffing, menu, ingredients, reservations, and rooms. You have full freedom to customize your inn to your heart's content—we won’t confine your creativity to grids. Whether you aim for the glory of a 5-star inn or simply enjoy serving each customer your way, the choice is yours.

[h2]Power of Networking[/h2]

You can't thrive in this world without friends. The bad news is you don't have the superpowers of foraging, farming, and crafting. The good news is that your network of farmers, herbalists, adventurers, builders, and even bandits can provide what you need. You'll need to manage these relationships. Invite them over for a meal, give gifts regularly, help them with favors, and host parties to build and maintain strong connections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/f2d0039c1f2124ae88458abf8a49a68346ecd5db.png[/img]

[h2]Strategic Conversation[/h2]

Often, the most important battles are not fought with swords or wands, but with words. Engage in conversations with characters in the form of card battles to attract them, negotiate prices, gather intelligence, or persuade them to do the right things. As a peace-keeping wizard who never condones violence, you'll wield the power of words to achieve your goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/27f0a1ec894f6a07a267c907c80c777b82e41a14.png[/img]

[h2]Magic Fantasy[/h2]

We admit it—we're huge Harry Potter fans. Imagine building your own Hogwarts from scratch. That's the idea that inspired us, and you can create your own magical haven in Magic Inn. With paintings of lively characters, floating candles, glow-in-the-dark vines, and more magical items in your inventory, you can build your own great hall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/0e209e65f02894458eb466614b508fb24a931776.png[/img]

Plus, you can cast spells and brew potions—your typical wizardry activities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/91050cf05df788a3da44bf9757024af7c0271748.png[/img]

[h1]The Story[/h1]

In short, you are a wizard with a mission, and innkeeping is just your disguise. The magical world is filled with secrets, schemes, and ambitions. But you'll also meet people with compassion, aspiration, and loyalty. Together, you'll become a formidable force based in the Magic Inn, working towards the greater good of the Kingdom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/191b6210a9605648620620ce7dfc10f5ccafc937.png[/img]

That's all for now. Thank you so much for reading. We'll dive deeper into each section with more details in future devlogs.

notes.title: Innkeeping in Magic Inn
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is Xiao from Purpledoor Studios, and welcome to our first Devlog of Magic Inn! Today, I’m thrilled to introduce the basics of innkeeping to all our future innkeepers and wizards. Grab your wands and aprons; it’s going to be a magical ride!

[h1]Dining[/h1]

Any proper inn should serve decent food; otherwise, we’d have hungry travelers yelling at us. In Magic Inn, you need to take up cooking, in the form of mini-games, to serve food orders from guests. The quality of food relies on both your cooking skill and how well you complete the cooking mini-games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/7428a6d76fbf79ec5400b293ef055bf4547640f6.png[/img]

Each guest only has limited patience, so you will need to hurry up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/9e25edff8cf82cd90c2c401f41d15949d12fd78e.gif[/img]

When the inn gets crowded, you could employ chefs and servers to scale up the operation.
You can also learn new magic spells or hire wizards to streamline operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/26dbe4a39c08fdaf933c0e1598a285498dce9757.png[/img]

[h1]Drinking[/h1]

You know what’s worse than not having food at an inn? Yep, you guessed it: not having alcohol.
In Magic Inn, preparing drinks is very similar to preparing food. You also complete a different set of mini-games where the result determines the drink quality, and you can hire servers to help out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/9b4fc98e74d8f350d1b8c636e7eb8119055b485a.png[/img]

We also want to add a special mechanism to drinking: a drunk meter. As you improve your conversation skills, you can recommend more drinks to guests, which fills up their drunk meter. When the meter is full, the guest will pass out, and you will lose the income. But if the drunk meter is near full, it gives you an advantage in conversation, where they will be more likely to spill their guts and say yes to your requests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/1e47507a05a9294d7751594ff102c98431579cb8.png[/img]

[h1]Room[/h1]

Compared to dining and drinking, rooms should be the most profitable part of the business.
The price of a room is determined by its value. You can add expensive furniture, beautiful decorations, and rare gems to increase the room value. Then you just sit back and relax while watching the cash roll in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/e4ad3cc57eefd81b27348207284f293b638c7fd3.png[/img]

More importantly, at night when the inn is closed, you can engage in conversation with guests who stay over. These conversations could turn into meaningful relationships that will benefit you in the long run. We will get into that part in a future Devlog.

We hope this gives you a little more insight into what innkeeping in Magic Inn is like.
Let us know your thoughts and feedback, fellow innkeepers!

notes.title: Your new game buddy - a magic broom
notes.content:
Hello, beloved Magic Inn Community

✨We're thrilled to introduce the new companion in Magic Inn - the Magic Broom! ✨

Bringing this to life has been a long process. We asked for suggestions on the CozyGamers Subreddit, and the community was incredibly supportive, helping us choose their favorite design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/27f5c3bfeecb6cb0e64cf6a9394cd77c4ec99cb4.png[/img]

With all the feedback, the top half of design #2 combined with the sassy pose of #3 was the favorite among cozy gamers. Then we drew the final design like this and also brainstorm some of other animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/bc302b9ca4d14e5ecc2975939b4094d8fcfda7e8.png[/img]

Two months passed and the 3D model was completed. We shared the result in the CozyGamers community and they said they are all impressed by the final design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44344346/56f180cd4a76e0da46eca328149ea8a669ca2626.png[/img]

The Magic Broom is now fully integrated into Magic Inn. As your game buddy, the broom will give your guidance when necessary. He can randomly fly in the air. Moreover, the way he talks to you can be really mean sometimes.

We hope this character brings a fresh experience to you all. Your support has been crucial in bringing this amazing design to life, and we're truly grateful for it.

Cheers!
